findings.evidence: Lines 159–164 already prove that `normalFormMap` has derivative `normalFormEquivL`; Mathlib `Analysis/Calculus/InverseFunctionTheorem/FDeriv.lean:108–116` places only `[CompleteSpace E]` on `HasStrictFDerivAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph`, while the extra completeness assumptions enter at `ImplicitFunctionData` (`Implicit.lean:99–104`).
findings.fix: Assume only `[CompleteSpace E]` and construct the chart directly from `hasStrictFDerivAt_normalFormMap` via `HasStrictFDerivAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph`; derive the inverse derivative from its local-inverse API.
findings.issue: `normalFormImplicitFunctionData` forces `[CompleteSpace 𝕜] [CompleteSpace F]` through `ImplicitFunctionData`, and this over-strengthens the chart, inverse, obstruction, and reconstruction declarations built from it.

summary: The local normal-form API unnecessarily requires completeness of the scalar field and codomain, although Mathlib's inverse function theorem only needs the source Banach space complete.
